C1400.title: Indexed Finance DAO Consecutive Governance Attacks
C1400.summary: The 2024 paper SoK: Attacks on DAOs systematically organizes attacks that occurred in practice, were proposed in theory, or were identified during audits. It uses Indexed Finance as a case study of two consecutive token-acquisition governance attacks, examining how attackers accumulated governance tokens and voting power to advance harmful proposals and distinguishing these social and governance-layer attacks from purely technical code vulnerabilities.
